mkdir -p "$WORK/.factory/logs"
PLUGIN_ROOT="/Users/zious/Documents/GITHUB/vsdd-factory/plugins/vsdd-factory"
DISPATCHER="$PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/dispatcher/bin/darwin-arm64/factory-dispatcher"
envelope='{"event_name":"PreToolUse","tool_name":"Bash","session_id":"rc23-smoke","tool_input":{"command":"echo hi"}}'
echo "=== Committed darwin-arm64 binary test ==="
echo "Dispatcher: $DISPATCHER"
echo "Mtime: $(ls -la "$DISPATCHER" | awk '{print $6,$7,$8}')"
echo "Envelope: $envelope"
echo ""
result=$(env CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT="$PLUGIN_ROOT" CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$WORK" VSDD_LOG_DIR="$WORK/.factory/logs" \
  bash -c "printf '%s' '$envelope' | '$DISPATCHER'" 2>&1)
exit_code=$?
echo "Exit code: $exit_code"
echo "Output: $result"
echo ""
echo "=== Internal log check ==="
ls -la "$WORK/.factory/logs/" 2>/dev/null
LOG_FILE=$(ls -1t "$WORK/.factory/logs/dispatcher-internal-"*.jsonl 2>/dev/null | head -1)
if [ -n "$LOG_FILE" ]; then
  echo "Log file: $LOG_FILE"
  echo "Events:"
  cat "$LOG_FILE" | python3 -c "import sys,json; [print(json.dumps(json.loads(l),indent=2)[:300]) for l in sys.stdin if l.strip()]" 2>/dev/null | head -60
else
  echo "No log file found"
fi
rm -rf "$WORK". Fix: Deleting .factory/, src/, or tests/ causes irreversible data loss. Remove specific files instead. Code: protected_path_delete.
